`Taking an occasional dose of ibuprofen with a small amount of alcohol is generally low-risk for healthy adults` , but regularly combining them, taking high doses, or drinking heavily raises your risk of serious side effects.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXa2gOb9_XNQe9bGKPiRlThaMbjvgRovlNTKPtXKHKT4K1fiu6RU8j7gyVn8RnO5bTM6vjrz-cSFB6Mrhs0MH3y9W88wR_UxAzMmdmyATKz0yG8SDPJ3XVWZzf5ZyuYnlwwv9blmSx70aw-f16uy-PmPr_y_II31o)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXqOZWkdvrx36cnOJz1Lt6RVMgZhcZiBHvFup8DQsaMCwz74aSBABVyXSKqkN-S5zFThRqnAophB6FI1s166PHNWUtt_37EXgZSVvSgnxk2vhgpZPVo21m6u5IOESH2sR1Pk1HX3obSLM7iM0p9LDT-CU)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkwEBxCJF18JrfIyixpUrQLM9-7AsWAFXtqflbVFcVdKqbQAgbN10ow23tGmw8xSunOk6GCdZtIo8ZrSUpHit7Pc0Fc4ki4llsYsTfNPs8-6bPQRxEw_jsdWUwFm_fUrKMJJy6X9gV6ihz2YFUT-8kN2gzTTKl6wiScPTgC0bBfR52k5ZS9Eq63z1bH3K9F6zxI4T2U8)

### Main Risks

- **Stomach and intestinal bleeding:** Both ibuprofen (an NSAID) and alcohol irritate the stomach lining. Combining them—especially if you take ibuprofen regularly or have 3 or more drinks a day—increases the risk of ulcers and bleeding.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF16bJ749yy6i8sMJKJNHjPYZlZaNd_vtjFGC43CH_51j3Y0Wx2DObl5cC-DE9U90LyjvtLDUXqpVHkAyhY1mB6YOwe3S6Od8r_N3jtYLyhTdYN6Dpt7TBrT4nowyNpxq4aEXh71LC7dC-bA2lxR6pIY-Rydyf5RBflERCkG5jxA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXa2gOb9_XNQe9bGKPiRlThaMbjvgRovlNTKPtXKHKT4K1fiu6RU8j7gyVn8RnO5bTM6vjrz-cSFB6Mrhs0MH3y9W88wR_UxAzMmdmyATKz0yG8SDPJ3XVWZzf5ZyuYnlwwv9blmSx70aw-f16uy-PmPr_y_II31o)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkwEBxCJF18JrfIyixpUrQLM9-7AsWAFXtqflbVFcVdKqbQAgbN10ow23tGmw8xSunOk6GCdZtIo8ZrSUpHit7Pc0Fc4ki4llsYsTfNPs8-6bPQRxEw_jsdWUwFm_fUrKMJJy6X9gV6ihz2YFUT-8kN2gzTTKl6wiScPTgC0bBfR52k5ZS9Eq63z1bH3K9F6zxI4T2U8)[[4]](https://www.drugs.com/video/ibuprofen-warnings-precautions-168/)
- **Kidney and liver strain:** Regular use of ibuprofen and alcohol together can strain your kidneys and liver, particularly if you already have liver, kidney, heart, or high blood pressure issues.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXqOZWkdvrx36cnOJz1Lt6RVMgZhcZiBHvFup8DQsaMCwz74aSBABVyXSKqkN-S5zFThRqnAophB6FI1s166PHNWUtt_37EXgZSVvSgnxk2vhgpZPVo21m6u5IOESH2sR1Pk1HX3obSLM7iM0p9LDT-CU)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXa2gOb9_XNQe9bGKPiRlThaMbjvgRovlNTKPtXKHKT4K1fiu6RU8j7gyVn8RnO5bTM6vjrz-cSFB6Mrhs0MH3y9W88wR_UxAzMmdmyATKz0yG8SDPJ3XVWZzf5ZyuYnlwwv9blmSx70aw-f16uy-PmPr_y_II31o)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF12t7y3SQGu9adCGp6_WmH1oXHrE2sCjZXp5BX-byj1JntmolJ7yXduaG8OrLGdSbjWDoRlXfBP-dO29ArTgcYX7vneUuOh14X-DnUJ2nNfpPOIGmIZ7CpFRs9rU-xmOO48FA2yEpmXIje_jKw23rB_x2-0Wtq9rCHDvso2BiyrThAsQ)
- **Drowsiness and impaired alertness:** Combining alcohol with medication can increase drowsiness and slow reaction times . Do not drive if you have been drinking.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF1xLFKC4enrIc5EzH_8_A1ZU6OM0UvCTbDDeYuk-HVIxI-B5WF9qV2bmW9PDXuakrrIMb62OEkDLDjByUnkbp4w3rUnfJsejxKxs5HZO-baDcN-uKel8OESx7gGKe_KJeypRpJQyWzdWn7CfTESK8Wr9aXxxGfLRtWjafd9jv6A)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXa2gOb9_XNQe9bGKPiRlThaMbjvgRovlNTKPtXKHKT4K1fiu6RU8j7gyVn8RnO5bTM6vjrz-cSFB6Mrhs0MH3y9W88wR_UxAzMmdmyATKz0yG8SDPJ3XVWZzf5ZyuYnlwwv9blmSx70aw-f16uy-PmPr_y_II31o)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF16bJ749yy6i8sMJKJNHjPYZlZaNd_vtjFGC43CH_51j3Y0Wx2DObl5cC-DE9U90LyjvtLDUXqpVHkAyhY1mB6YOwe3S6Od8r_N3jtYLyhTdYN6Dpt7TBrT4nowyNpxq4aEXh71LC7dC-bA2lxR6pIY-Rydyf5RBflERCkG5jxA)

### Practical Precautions

- **Timing:** Some sources suggest waiting at least **10 hours** after taking ibuprofen before drinking alcohol, and up to **24 hours** after drinking alcohol before taking ibuprofen (longer if you have liver issues). For more timing and safety details, see [GoodRx](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXqOZWkdvrx36cnOJz1Lt6RVMgZhcZiBHvFup8DQsaMCwz74aSBABVyXSKqkN-S5zFThRqnAophB6FI1s166PHNWUtt_37EXgZSVvSgnxk2vhgpZPVo21m6u5IOESH2sR1Pk1HX3obSLM7iM0p9LDT-CU) and [Drugs.com](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF12t7y3SQGu9adCGp6_WmH1oXHrE2sCjZXp5BX-byj1JntmolJ7yXduaG8OrLGdSbjWDoRlXfBP-dO29ArTgcYX7vneUuOh14X-DnUJ2nNfpPOIGmIZ7CpFRs9rU-xmOO48FA2yEpmXIje_jKw23rB_x2-0Wtq9rCHDvso2BiyrThAsQ).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXqOZWkdvrx36cnOJz1Lt6RVMgZhcZiBHvFup8DQsaMCwz74aSBABVyXSKqkN-S5zFThRqnAophB6FI1s166PHNWUtt_37EXgZSVvSgnxk2vhgpZPVo21m6u5IOESH2sR1Pk1HX3obSLM7iM0p9LDT-CU)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkwEBxCJF18JrfIyixpUrQLM9-7AsWAFXtqflbVFcVdKqbQAgbN10ow23tGmw8xSunOk6GCdZtIo8ZrSUpHit7Pc0Fc4ki4llsYsTfNPs8-6bPQRxEw_jsdWUwFm_fUrKMJJy6X9gV6ihz2YFUT-8kN2gzTTKl6wiScPTgC0bBfR52k5ZS9Eq63z1bH3K9F6zxI4T2U8)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF12t7y3SQGu9adCGp6_WmH1oXHrE2sCjZXp5BX-byj1JntmolJ7yXduaG8OrLGdSbjWDoRlXfBP-dO29ArTgcYX7vneUuOh14X-DnUJ2nNfpPOIGmIZ7CpFRs9rU-xmOO48FA2yEpmXIje_jKw23rB_x2-0Wtq9rCHDvso2BiyrThAsQ)
- **Stick to recommended limits:** Take the lowest effective dose of ibuprofen for the shortest time needed, and avoid exceeding recommended daily limits.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF16bJ749yy6i8sMJKJNHjPYZlZaNd_vtjFGC43CH_51j3Y0Wx2DObl5cC-DE9U90LyjvtLDUXqpVHkAyhY1mB6YOwe3S6Od8r_N3jtYLyhTdYN6Dpt7TBrT4nowyNpxq4aEXh71LC7dC-bA2lxR6pIY-Rydyf5RBflERCkG5jxA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXg7e_7umLik3oVpi-siOaA_ppdu-Z0p9hJAuX4RviJ2aVElxozcez5hSftq3YmgUqa7YLIdNw7Ci9n43DmILyNaFsNLF8uIoXybK9Inl96bcMIpnJ0rkrF3V0ZpUTsaybLANSFkVQQDCQuxlOLaPTa487VYueHPQx)
- **Take with food:** Food or milk can help reduce stomach irritation from ibuprofen.[[1]](https://www.drugs.com/video/ibuprofen-warnings-precautions-168/)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXWoQXdpUSvxtLvTHpj3XbRsIB6bUExu89-TAVkZisoXHQeq_qJT6S9JDnq_SvA_HKfywN81AU-hyqReoNlr6aAZlPYk9dUqFtLmnOI9A6R-CaBewE9RHDEdqD2MocYHoPiGJv99rk8oSHoOxY5JCPCkc)
- **Be cautious with hangovers:** Your stomach may already be irritated, and alcohol may still be in your system.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF16bJ749yy6i8sMJKJNHjPYZlZaNd_vtjFGC43CH_51j3Y0Wx2DObl5cC-DE9U90LyjvtLDUXqpVHkAyhY1mB6YOwe3S6Od8r_N3jtYLyhTdYN6Dpt7TBrT4nowyNpxq4aEXh71LC7dC-bA2lxR6pIY-Rydyf5RBflERCkG5jxA)

For a full breakdown of symptoms and risks, review [Healthline](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXa2gOb9_XNQe9bGKPiRlThaMbjvgRovlNTKPtXKHKT4K1fiu6RU8j7gyVn8RnO5bTM6vjrz-cSFB6Mrhs0MH3y9W88wR_UxAzMmdmyATKz0yG8SDPJ3XVWZzf5ZyuYnlwwv9blmSx70aw-f16uy-PmPr_y_II31o) . Seek prompt medical care if you notice signs of stomach bleeding (such as black or tarry stools, severe stomach pain, or vomiting blood or material that looks like coffee grounds) or kidney issues (such as swelling in your hands, feet, or ankles, unusual tiredness, or shortness of breath).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXa2gOb9_XNQe9bGKPiRlThaMbjvgRovlNTKPtXKHKT4K1fiu6RU8j7gyVn8RnO5bTM6vjrz-cSFB6Mrhs0MH3y9W88wR_UxAzMmdmyATKz0yG8SDPJ3XVWZzf5ZyuYnlwwv9blmSx70aw-f16uy-PmPr_y_II31o)[[2]](https://www.drugs.com/video/ibuprofen-warnings-precautions-168/)If you'd like more tailored information, let me know:

- **How much ibuprofen** you're taking and **how often** 
- **How much alcohol** you plan to drink or recently had
- Any **health conditions** (like stomach, kidney, or liver issues) or **other medications** you take
